Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling in the left-hand lane and began a left turn at an intersection in Pearland, Texas, when the
vehicle was struck on its driver side by Driver 2, who was proceeding straight through the same intersection. Driver 1
reported neck and back strain following the impact and was transported for evaluation. A Passenger was also in the
vehicle at the time of the collision, and both the responding officer and the statements taken at the scene confirm that
person's presence in the car. No independent witnesses were located at the scene, so the account of the collision
rests on the statements of the drivers and the physical evidence. Photographs taken at the scene confirm several
details of the sequence, including the point of contact and the final resting positions of both vehicles. The damage to
Driver 1's vehicle is largely consistent with the described impact, and the reported injuries appear consistent with the
type and force of a side collision of this kind. Nothing at the scene indicated prior damage to the vehicle. Driver 1 is
listed as a named insured on the policy covering the vehicle involved.
